visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair and a person wearing a long blonde wig and a white lace dress dance together in front of a pleated beige curtain. They perform rhythmic hand movements and spins. Both are wearing white dresses. The room is brightly lit with even studio lighting. (2) The camera transitions to a close-up selfie view. The woman with black hair holds the phone while the person in the blonde wig poses and touches their cheek. They are smiling and talking. The background shows a white door and the beige curtain. (3) A product sequence begins. A hand with decorated nails opens a light purple Maybelline cushion foundation compact. It demonstrates swiping the sponge over the cream product. Later, the product is applied to a person's cheek to cover a blemish. Close-up shots highlight the texture. (4) The scene shows a close-up of a purple liquid blush bottle with a bright yellow cap. It is followed by a demonstration of a purple makeup sponge applicator being used on a forearm to show the blending effect of the foundation. The lighting is focused. (5) The two main characters reappear in a medium shot, sitting and laughing. They hold up the foundation compacts towards the camera. The person in the blonde wig makes exaggerated facial expressions. They are both looking directly into the lens and gesturing with their hands.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic pop music with female vocals singing "I'm a bad girl" starts the video. A male voice yells "Woo!" and "Wow!" with high arousal. The beat is strong, estimated at 125 BPM. No ambient noise is audible over the loud music. (2) The music volume decreases as the female voice speaks clearly, "跳完舞...". A male voice responds with a comedic, high-pitched tone, teasing about the makeup. There is a "ding" sound effect when text appears on the screen. The voices are articulate. (3) A "whoosh" sound effect marks a transition. The male voice adopts a professional narrative tone, explaining the "three steps" for applying cushion foundation. Soft synth pads and a gentle rhythmic beat continue in the background. His speech is clear and authoritative yet friendly. (4) Loud laughter and excited shouting ("哎呀呀呀!") from the male speaker occur as he reacts to the makeup results. The vocal arousal is very high. Multiple "pop" sound effects accompany the appearance of various instructional text overlays on the screen. (5) The audio transitions to a closing sequence with upbeat music. Both voices are heard laughing and debating who is the "C-position" of the group. The male voice screams playfully at the end, followed by loud laughter and room resonance.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Humorous Dialogue -> Product Tutorial -> Demonstration -> Closing CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: Promoting Maybelline's new cushion foundation and blush products through a humorous and engaging 'girl group' style video featuring influencers Zhang Yi and Cindy. It combines trending music and dance with an informative tutorial to show the product's effectiveness on camera.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product demonstration, brand logos, explicit call-to-action, and promotional text overlays for Maybelline.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A high-production value social media advertisement utilizing influencer humor and fast-paced editing to market beauty products.
